# tenure place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenurePlace`](gmeow-tenurePlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenurePlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The place (parcel, lot, or spatial unit) over which the rights of this [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) apply. Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity).
